remarks: Welcome to 4 Stanton Road - a beautifully maintained Colonial located on a quiet, tree-lined street in one of Darien's most sought-after neighborhoods. This spacious and sun-filled 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home offers gracious living space, comfort, convenience, and classic New England charm.  Property Features:  5 generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet.  Gourmet kitchen with breakfast nook, and family room with fireplace.  Formal dining room and spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace.  Finished lower level ideal for a home office, gym, or playroom.  Beautifully landscaped yard with deck - perfect for outdoor entertaining.  Attached 2-car garage and ample storage throughout
